title: When unclear words become scripture
literal_meaning: When Brahma speaks incoherently, it is the Veda.
explanation: The saying makes the speaker’s standing outweigh the clarity of the words. Even incoherent speech is received as scripture when it comes from Brahma. The dictionary places this example under the sense “to speak incoherently” and labels it a Dhaga. The further reading offered here is satirical: a statement can acquire authority merely because of who says it. That is an editorial interpretation of the contrast, not a doctrinal account of the Vedas.
meaning_odia: ବ୍ରହ୍ମା ବିଳିବିଳେଇଲେ ବି ତାହା ବେଦ। କଥା କେତେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ, ତାହାଠାରୁ କିଏ କହୁଛି ସେ କଥା ବଡ଼ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅନର୍ଥକ ବାକ୍ୟ କହିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ଏହି ଢଗଟି ଉଦାହରଣ ହୋଇଛି। ଏଠାରେ ଆମର ପାଠ ହେଉଛି ମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦାର ଜୋର ଉପରେ ଏକ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ—ବଡ଼ ଲୋକ କହିଛନ୍ତି ବୋଲି ଅସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କଥାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଭ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଧରିନେବା।
english_summary: A speaker’s prestige can make unclear words seem authoritative.
odia_summary: କହୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦାରେ ଅସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କଥା ବି ପ୍ରମାଣ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
usage_example: A vague remark by a famous speaker is repeated as a firm rule, although nobody can explain what was meant. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: Brahma and the Veda remain the source’s cultural anchors. The dictionary supports the lexical sense and identifies the example as Dhaga; the prestige-over-clarity interpretation is Project Odisha’s reading. No originating scripture passage or religious teaching is asserted, and the saying is not attributed to Brahma as its author.

odia: ବୋହି ଗଲା ପାଣି ଯାଉ ତେଣିକି, ବନ୍ଧେଇଲା ପାଣି ରହୁ ଅଟକି
title: What has flowed, what remains
literal_meaning: Let the water that has flowed away go that way; let the dammed water remain held.
explanation: The two wishes face different water: what has already gone and what can remain contained. Our reading turns attention from recovering every loss to keeping what is still available. This is an editorial application of the contrast, not a promise that every loss can be repaired by restraint.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଇଟି ଇଚ୍ଛା ଦୁଇ ଅବସ୍ଥାର ପାଣିକୁ ନେଇ—ଯାହା ବୋହିଗଲା ଓ ଯାହା ଅଟକି ରହିଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ହରାଇଥିବା ଜିନିଷ ଫେରାଇବାଠାରୁ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଏବେ ଥିବା ଜିନିଷକୁ ରଖିବା ଆଡ଼କୁ ଫେରେ। ଏହା ବିରୋଧଟିର ଆମର ପ୍ରୟୋଗ; ସଂଯମରେ ସବୁ କ୍ଷତି ଭରଣା ହେବ ବୋଲି ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Our reading distinguishes a past loss from what can still be kept.
odia_summary: ବିତିଥିବା କ୍ଷତି ଓ ରଖିପାରିବା ଜିନିଷ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଆମ ପଢ଼ାର ତଫାତ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ବର୍ଷାରେ ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ରର ଗୋଟିଏ ଦିନ ବାତିଲ ହେଲା। ଆୟୋଜକ ସେଦିନକୁ ନେଇ ଅନୁତାପ କରୁଥିବାବେଳେ ସାଙ୍ଗ ଢଗଟି ମନେ ପକାଇ କହିଲେ, “ଆସନ୍ତା ଦୁଇଦିନର ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା କରିବା।” / Rain cancels one day of a reading programme. While an organiser regrets it, a friend recalls the saying: “Let us arrange the two days still ahead.” This application is invented.
cultural_context: The verb’s dam-building sense supports the water image. No particular river, engineering method, conservation custom or practical water-management instruction is documented here.
